mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear over Badger Prairie County Park with a full moon visible. Although the ISS passes overhead tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city has announced that a section of Highway M will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for final pavement work, requiring drivers to follow posted detours. Also, remember to protect yourself from scams by never paying city planning fees via wire transfer or online credit card.

There is plenty to do in our area today, including the Dane County Farmers Market, plus live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on September 28 or trivia nights starting on September 29.
In a noteworthy call from September 5, officers discovered multiple vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields, identified as part of a viral social media prank.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open, so head over before they close their doors at 10:30 PM tonight.
